scene amimayamalloween1
: Hey! Wanna sing a duet with me? I was planning on doing Niki’s Christmas song, but we can do something else if you’re still all emotional about the amount of my dad’s jizz that she’s swallowed.
lines.zh: 嘿！想跟我合唱吗？我本来打算唱 Niki 的圣诞歌，不过要是你还因为她吞了我爸多少精液而情绪激动，我们也可以换一首。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. True. Yet it is I, Maya, who is not currently estranged from him and has been chosen once more as the object of his affection. Get fucked.
lines.zh: 哈哈哈。说得对。不过现在和他闹翻的人不是我，是我 Maya 又一次被选为他爱慕的对象。去你的。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween2
: I’d love to, but I feel like I’d have to top wearing this outfit and I kind of just want to be tied up and edged for the next nine hours. When do you think he and Ayane will be back?
lines.zh: 我也想啊，不过穿着这身衣服我大概只能当在上面那个，而我这会儿就只想被人绑起来、被吊在高潮边缘折磨上九个小时。你觉得他和 Ayane 什么时候回来？

lines.en: : {size=-3}I don’t know. But I’m going to go out on a limb here and submit a formal verbal request for you to stop being a domineering, manipulative bitch for one night so I can go to town on him without fear of you interfering once he is.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}我不知道。不过我斗胆在这儿正式口头申请一次：请你今晚别再当那个控制欲强、爱摆布的婊子，好让我能尽情对他下手，不用怕你等他回来之后再来搅局。{/size}

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween3
: Wow. You and Ayane are {i}both{/i} super forward tonight. What brought this on?
lines.zh: 哇。你和 Ayane 今晚{i}都{/i}这么直接啊。怎么突然这样了？

lines.en: : Love.
lines.zh: 因为爱。

lines.en: : What a boring answer. The lead-up made me feel like it would be a little more interesting than just that.
lines.zh: 这答案真无聊。铺垫了半天，我还以为会比这个有意思一点。

lines.en: : I’m annoyed that there has to be a lead-up at all. But seeing as you’d probably just cock-block me again if I tried something {i}without{/i} telling you, here I am.
lines.zh: 我本来就烦还要什么铺垫。不过考虑到我要是{i}不{/i}跟你说就动手，你大概又会来搅我的好事，所以我就来了。

lines.en: : So please, Ami — fearful and all-powerful master of time — allow me to fuck your dad without worrying about you getting in the way. I am literally desperate.
lines.zh: 所以求你了，Ami——可怕又全能的时间之主——让我跟你爸上床吧，别让我还得担心你从中作梗。我真的、真的很饥渴。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}look{/i} desperate. Get on your knees and ask again.
lines.zh: 你{i}看着{/i}可不怎么饥渴。跪下，再求一次。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween4
: Fine. Oh, Ami — queen of the universe and champion of paternal cock-
lines.zh: 行吧。哦，Ami——宇宙的女王、父亲鸡巴的冠军——

lines.en: : Okay, okay! Get up. I didn’t think you’d actually do it right in front of everyone.
lines.zh: 好了好了！起来吧。我没想到你真会当着所有人的面跪。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween5
: You really {i}are{/i} desperate, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 你{i}确实{/i}是很饥渴，对吧？

lines.en: : I finally have a chance to make him mine again and I will stop at absolutely nothing to ensure that happens.
lines.zh: 我终于有机会让他重新属于我了，为了实现这一点，我什么事都做得出来。

lines.en: : He’ll never be {i}yours,{/i} Maya. So don’t go getting your hopes up just because he told you he loves you or something. I’m guessing that’s what happened, right?
lines.zh: 他永远不会是{i}你的{/i}，Maya。所以别因为他说了句爱你什么的就抱太大期待。我猜是这么回事吧？

lines.en: : Yes. And know that if you reverse time again to a point where that {i}didn’t{/i} happen, I will find you and gut you.
lines.zh: 是的。还有，你给我记住：如果你再把时间倒回到那件事{i}没{/i}发生的时候，我会找到你，把你开膛破肚。

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you I can’t do that?
lines.zh: 我要说多少次你才明白，我做不到？

lines.en: : Zero more if you give me permission to have passionate, violent, uninhibited sex with your father tonight.
lines.zh: 只要你答应我今晚和你爸来一场激情、粗暴、毫无顾忌的性爱，我就一次都不问了。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween6
: How about I just break out the magic wand again? That’s so much easier and less messy, don’t you think?
lines.zh: 不如我再掏出那根魔法棒吧？那样简单多了，也不至于弄得一片狼藉，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Ami, that is not the same and you know it.
lines.zh: Ami，那根本不是一回事，你心里清楚。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween7
: It’s probably better if orgasm frequency is the metric we’re going by. How many did you have the last time I tied you up again? You really think my dad is going to beat that?
lines.zh: 如果按高潮次数来算，那大概还更好。上次我把你绑起来的时候你来了几次？你真觉得我爸能超过那个数？

lines.en: : You look angry. Why?
lines.zh: 你看起来很生气。为什么？

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween8
: What do you mean {i}why?!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么{/i}是什么意思？！

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween9
: It’s bad enough that my boyfriend...thing’s {i}daughter{/i} has repeatedly raped me, but it’s even {i}worse{/i} when she brags about it and holds it over my head like it’s something I {i}want!{/i}
lines.zh: 我男朋……那什么的{i}女儿{/i}反复强奸我，这已经够糟了，更{i}糟{/i}的是她还拿这事到处炫耀，还当成我{i}想要{/i}的东西一样压在我头上！

lines.en: : Oh yeah. That does sound pretty bad, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 哦，是啊。听起来是挺惨的，对吧？

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} bad!
lines.zh: {i}就是{/i}很惨！

lines.en: : Hmm...then how come you liked it so much?
lines.zh: 嗯……那你当时为什么那么喜欢？

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween10
: How come {i}you{/i} did?! You’re straight! At least {i}I’m{/i} attracted to girls!
lines.zh: 那{i}你{/i}为什么也喜欢？！你可是直女！至少{i}我{/i}本来就喜欢女生！

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween11
: Awww, you’re attracted to me? That’s so sweet. But I’m sorry, Maya — my heart belongs to someone else. And having sex with him will not make your feelings for me simply disappear.
lines.zh: 哇，你被我吸引了？真让人感动。不过抱歉，Maya——我的心已经属于别人了。而且和他上床并不会让你对我的感情就这么消失。

lines.en: : Whatever you want, name it. I’ll do it. Just put your psychopath shit on hold for {i}one{/i} night. That is {i}all{/i} I ask.
lines.zh: 你想要什么，说吧。我什么都做。只要你把你那套疯子把戏{i}停{/i}一晚上。我{i}只{/i}求这一件事。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween12
: You know, you should really think higher of yourself, Maya. Girls as cute as you shouldn’t be {i}begging{/i} for anything.
lines.zh: 说真的，你该把自己看得高一点，Maya。像你这么可爱的女孩不该{i}乞求{/i}任何东西。

lines.en: : You should just take whatever it is you want. That’s what I do and it’s working pretty well for me.
lines.zh: 你想要什么，直接拿就是了。我就是这么干的，而且效果还不错。

lines.en: : Yes. Well {i}you{/i} don’t have to deal with the looming threat of being abused by an omniscient being!
lines.zh: 是吗。可{i}你{/i}不用面对被一个全知的存在玩弄的威胁啊！

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween13
: Ah, yes. Sounds horrible. Boo-hoo.
lines.zh: 啊，是啊。听起来真可怕。呜呜呜。

lines.en: : {i}Anything.{/i} Just name it. I’ll let you tie me up for an entire {i}week{/i} if that’s what you want. Just leave us alone for one night.
lines.zh: {i}什么都可以。{/i}你开口就行。你要是想，我可以让你把我绑上整整{i}一个星期{/i}。只要今晚别来打扰我们。

lines.en: : Just do it. You don’t need to ask me for permission. And I don’t need anything in return.
lines.zh: 去做就是了。你不需要征求我的同意。我也不需要任何回报。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween14
: ...What?
lines.zh: ……什么？

lines.en: : I’m waiting for the catch.
lines.zh: 我在等那个陷阱。

lines.en: : There {i}is{/i} no catch. I kind of want to just hang out and enjoy Christmalloween tonight. If you want to fuck my dad, Maya — you go right ahead.
lines.zh: {i}没有{/i}什么陷阱。我今晚就想好好玩、好好享受这个圣诞万圣节。你要是想跟我爸上床，Maya——尽管去。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween15
: Perhaps I did not make myself abundantly clear. I want to do that {i}without you being involved in any capacity.{/i}
lines.zh: 也许我说得还不够明白。我想要的是{i}你以任何形式都不要掺和进来{/i}。

lines.en: : Do not watch. Do not {i}listen.{/i} And do not waltz into the room with a strap-on and join him in penetrating me, despite how insanely hot that sounds.
lines.zh: 不许看。不许{i}听{/i}。也不许大摇大摆地戴着假阳具走进房间，和他一起进来插我——尽管光是想想就他妈的够刺激。

lines.en: : Do not wait outside of the door and say some sketchy shit once we’re done. Do not {i}talk{/i} to me about it once we’re done. Just let it happen and exist elsewhere. Do you understand?
lines.zh: 不许在门外等着，等我们完事了再来甩几句怪话。完事之后也不许跟我{i}谈{/i}这件事。就让它发生，你到别处待着去。明白吗？

lines.en: : So, are we going to sing a duet or not? I don’t want to just stand here and hog the mic all night.
lines.zh: 所以，我们到底唱不唱二重唱？我可不想整晚站在这儿霸着麦克风。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween16
: {i}Leave. Us. Alone.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}离。我。们。远。点。{/i}

lines.en: : Again, I {i}will.{/i} You’ve {i}earned{/i} a night or two of uninhibited debauchery after all I’ve put you through. And in the spirit of Christmalloween, I will give that to you. No strings attached.
lines.zh: 再说一遍，我{i}会的{/i}。在我让你受了这么多罪之后，你{i}该{/i}得到一两晚毫无顾忌的放纵。本着圣诞万圣节的精神，我把它送给你。不带任何附加条件。

lines.en: : There are {i}always{/i} strings attached with you when I’m basically your fucking puppet now.
lines.zh: 可跟你就{i}永远{/i}有附加条件——毕竟我现在基本上就是你的提线木偶了。

lines.en: : And what a cute puppet you are.
lines.zh: 而且还是个特别可爱的木偶。

lines.en: : Just imagine I’m leaving you in the box tonight. And if someone comes along and borrows you for a little while, I’ll be none the wiser if they put you back like normal before I open it again.
lines.zh: 你就当是我今晚把你留在盒子里。要是有人路过把你借去玩一会儿，只要在我打开之前把你原样放回去，我也不会多知道什么。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween17
: Perhaps I did not make myself abundantly clear — part two. If all goes according to plan, I will most definitely {i}not{/i} be returned “like normal.”
lines.zh: 也许我说得还不够明白——第二回合。如果一切按计划进行，我绝对不会{i}原样{/i}被还回去。

lines.en: : I will be broken and bruised and inflated by the semen of an adult man that I will allow to have complete and total control over my body. I will be used and abused and perhaps even killed.
lines.zh: 我会被弄坏、满身淤青，被一个成年男人的精液撑得鼓胀起来——而我会允许他完全彻底地支配我的身体。我会被使用、被糟蹋，甚至可能会被弄死。

lines.en: : {size=-2}And this will be okay, for it is what I want. And when that happens and I am returned to your “box” like the cum-rag I intend to become tonight, I want you to close it, lock it, and hurl it off a bridge to never be seen again.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}而这没关系，因为这就是我想要的。等到那一刻，当我像今晚注定要变成的那块擦精布的模样被放回你的「盒子」里时，我要你把它合上、锁好，然后从桥上扔下去，永远别再让人看见。{/size}

lines.en: : You’re putting a lot of stake in the sexual capabilities of my father. I still think you’d be better off handing me the reins if that’s the outcome you desire, Maya.
lines.zh: 你在我爸的性能力上押的注可真大。我还是觉得，如果你想要的是这种结局，把缰绳交给我会更好，Maya。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween18
: Do {i}not{/i} interfere.
lines.zh: {i}别{/i}来搅局。

lines.en: : Can you send me a picture at least? The thought of you in such a despicable state is kind of turning me on.
lines.zh: 至少给我发张照片吧？一想到你那副狼狈样子，我有点兴奋了。

lines.en: : Goodbye.
lines.zh: 再见。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween19
: Does this mean I have to sing alone?
lines.zh: 那我是不是得一个人唱了？

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween20
: Things are still somewhat awkward between us now, aren’t they?
lines.zh: 我们之间现在还是有点尴尬，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m glad {i}you{/i} said it. Which isn’t to say I wouldn’t be able to. It just shows that you’re becoming a little better at understanding human emotion.
lines.zh: 我很高兴这话是{i}你{/i}先说的。倒不是说我说不出口。只是这说明你在理解人类情感方面进步了一点点。

lines.en: : Perhaps that’s intentional?
lines.zh: 也许那是刻意为之？

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween21
: So you’re a sociopath on purpose?
lines.zh: 所以你是故意当个反社会人格的？

lines.en: : I’m just saying — the more you understand something, the harder it becomes to write.
lines.zh: 我只是说——你对一样东西理解得越深，就越难把它写出来。

lines.en: : You stop thinking {i}outside{/i} of the lines and pigeonhole yourself into adhering to a set of predetermined standards and expectations.
lines.zh: 你不再{i}跳出{/i}条条框框去思考，而是把自己框进一套预设好的标准和期待里。

lines.en: : I’m likely just preaching to the choir, though. Seeing as you’re a writer yourself, of course.
lines.zh: 不过我大概是在班门弄斧。毕竟你自己也是个写作者。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween22
: Calling me a “writer” is generous when I’m average at best.
lines.zh: 我充其量也就算个平庸，叫我「作家」实在太抬举了。

lines.en: : Van Gogh was an average artist until he lopped off an ear and shot himself in the chest.
lines.zh: 梵高在割下自己的耳朵、朝胸口开了一枪之前，也不过是个平庸的画家。

lines.en: : I’m not even sure I could shoot myself in the chest properly given the size of my breasts.
lines.zh: 就我这胸的尺寸，我真不确定自己能不能好好地朝胸口开一枪。

lines.en: : I suppose an ear will do then. Though, I can’t help but fear what Akira would do with such a thing. So I’ll gladly volunteer to be the recipient instead, should you be so inclined.
lines.zh: 那大概一只耳朵也行。不过我忍不住会担心 Akira 拿到那东西会做出什么来。所以如果你有意，我很乐意自告奋勇当那个接收的人。

lines.en: : I feel like this conversation is somehow making our relationship even {i}more{/i} awkward.
lines.zh: 我怎么觉得这段对话反而让我们的关系变{i}更{/i}尴尬了。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween23
: That seems highly plausible. I imagine this is a poor time to tell you I miss you, then?
lines.zh: 听起来很有可能。那么，我想现在说我想你，大概不是时候吧？

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween24
: I’ve been feeling somewhat reflective lately. Nostalgic, even.
lines.zh: 我最近变得有点爱回想。甚至有点怀旧。

lines.en: : And though the vast majority of my early memories are that of dark rooms granted temporary life in the form of a faded book-light, there’s one other constant that always comes to mind.
lines.zh: 虽然我早年绝大部分的记忆，都是些被一盏昏暗的书灯短暂照亮的黑房间，但还有一个恒久不变的东西总会浮上心头。

lines.en: : And it’s one I neglected to properly care for. For that, I can’t help but be sorry.
lines.zh: 而那是我没有好好珍惜的东西。为此，我忍不住感到抱歉。

lines.en: : I understand that I am not {i}easy{/i} to understand. And that most have come to know me as a self-motivated “x-factor” of sorts. I imagine they’re correct to a certain extent as well.
lines.zh: 我知道我并不{i}容易{/i}被理解。大多数人都把我当成某种只顾自己的「未知数」。我想他们在某种程度上是对的。

lines.en: : I do value myself higher than others. But I believe that is the way everyone {i}should{/i} be as human progress is inhibited and suppressed by selflessness at the expense of individuality.
lines.zh: 我确实把自己看得比别人重。但我认为每个人都{i}应该{/i}如此——因为以牺牲个性为代价的无私，只会阻碍和压制人类的进步。

lines.en: : Distractions like this, like {i}you,{/i} can be dangerous when it comes to time-sensitive and potentially life-altering action or information. So the logical decision is to cast such things aside.
lines.zh: 像这样的干扰，像{i}你{/i}这样的干扰，在面对有时效性、甚至可能改变人生的行动或信息时，是很危险的。所以合乎逻辑的做法就是把这些东西丢到一边。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween25
: Nodoka...I don’t want to just be “logic” to you anymore. I’m a human being, not a factor in some equation you concocted about the most efficient way to exist.
lines.zh: Nodoka……我不想再只是你眼里那个「逻辑」了。我是个人，不是你为了让存在效率最大化而编出来的某个公式里的变量。

lines.en: : Again, it appears I’m failing to properly convey my feelings. So perhaps the struggle lies within me not understanding {i}myself.{/i} At least not fully.
lines.zh: 看来我又没能好好传达我的感受。也许问题出在我并不理解{i}我自己{/i}。至少不完全理解。

lines.en: : But there’s something I do understand, Futaba. And it’s that I don’t enjoy {i}existing{/i} much at all when I’m not doing it with you.
lines.zh: 但有一件事我是明白的，Futaba。那就是当我不和你一起的时候，我一点都不享受{i}活着{/i}这件事。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween26

: {size=-2}So efficiency be damned if that is the root cause of this feeling. And damn the girl called Nodoka Nagasawa as well for thinking she could do justice to the one who sneaks in with the faded book-light.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}所以，如果效率是这种感觉的根源，那就让效率见鬼去吧。也让那个叫 Nodoka Nagasawa 的女孩见鬼去吧——她竟以为自己能把那个带着昏暗书灯悄悄溜进来的人写好。{/size}

lines.en: : Despite the pedestal you place me on, I, too, struggle when it comes to pen and paper. And so that is the reason I believe you to be just as much of a writer as anyone else.
lines.zh: 尽管你把我捧得那么高，我在纸笔面前也同样挣扎。正因如此，我才相信你和任何人一样都是个作家。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween27
: I think that’s {i}actually{/i} the sweetest thing you’ve ever said to me.
lines.zh: 我觉得这{i}真的{/i}是你对我说过最动听的话了。

lines.en: : Yes, well...ethylene glycol is sweet as well. It doesn’t mean you should ingest it.
lines.zh: 是吗，嗯……乙二醇也是甜的。可那不代表你该把它喝下去。

lines.en: : I will likely continue to make things hard for you. And upset you in ways that feel both disappointing and spontaneous.
lines.zh: 我大概还会继续让你难受。还会用那种既让人失望又突如其来的方式让你难过。

lines.en: : So much so that the logical decision for {i}you{/i} would be to cut me off entirely. Yet my expected selfishness compels me to drag you down and ask that you reconsider such a thing.
lines.zh: 严重到{i}你{/i}按逻辑应该干脆跟我一刀两断。可我那不出所料的自私，又驱使我拉着你往下坠，求你重新考虑这件事。

lines.en: : I never wanted to cut you off, Nodoka. I don’t enjoy existing as much without you either...
lines.zh: 我从来没想过要跟你断，Nodoka。没有你，我活着也一样没那么开心……

lines.en: : You’ve always been an inspiration to me. And I find it harder to just...well, do {i}anything{/i} when you’re not around for me to look up to.
lines.zh: 你一直是我的灵感来源。当你不在身边、让我没法仰望的时候，我连……嗯，{i}任何事{/i}都更难做下去。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween28
: But so many things you do just make me {i}sad.{/i} Or angry. And knowing you’re not going to change them makes it hard to just...indefinitely tolerate it.
lines.zh: 可你做的那么多事都只会让我{i}难过{/i}。或者生气。而且知道你不会改，就让我很难……一直这么容忍下去。

lines.en: : Like...putting the most personal moments of my life into a book? For the whole world to see?
lines.zh: 比如……把我人生中最私密的时刻写进书里？让全世界都看到？

lines.en: : All I wanted was for others to feel the same way about you that I do. And that seeing the way the world perceives you would help reshape the ways in which you perceive yourself.
lines.zh: 我只是想让别人也像我一样看待你。也想让你看到世界怎么看你，从而重塑你看待自己的方式。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween29
: The way I perceive myself isn’t something that anyone else’s thoughts are going to change.
lines.zh: 我看待自己的方式，不是别人的想法能改变的。

lines.en: : It is a burden I must bear and something that only {i}I{/i} can counter.
lines.zh: 这是必须由我背负的重担，也只有{i}我{/i}自己能与之抗衡。

lines.en: : But you are failing...aren’t you?
lines.zh: 可你现在正在失败……对吧？

lines.en: : What happens if you do?
lines.zh: 如果你真的失败了会怎样？

lines.en: : There will be no room for a sequel, will there?
lines.zh: 那就没有续集的空间了，对吧？

lines.en: : Probably not...no.
lines.zh: 大概……没有。

lines.en: : How frustrating it is that there are so many problems in this world that can’t be solved even when one knows {i}how{/i} to solve them.
lines.zh: 这世上竟有那么多问题，即便你{i}知道{/i}该怎么解决也解决不了，真是让人泄气。

lines.en: : Just one more case where it’s better to know nothing at all than everything at once.
lines.zh: 又是一个例子：与其一下子什么都知道，不如什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Knowing nothing sounds nice.
lines.zh: 什么都不知道听起来挺好的。

lines.en: : I miss being a kid sometimes. I miss my biggest problems being the littlest things out there.
lines.zh: 我有时候挺想念小时候的。想念那时候我最大的烦恼都是些微不足道的小事。

lines.en: : I mean, technically speaking-
lines.zh: 我的意思是，严格来说——

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween30
: You know what I mean.
lines.zh: 你懂我意思。

lines.en: : I know everything. That’s kind of my shtick. And also the thorn in my side.
lines.zh: 我什么都知道。这算是我的招牌，也是扎在我肋下的那根刺。

lines.en: scene amimayamalloween31
: But I think I’m getting closer lately. To finally pulling it out. And finding the answers to the questions I’ve been asking all my life.
lines.zh: 但我觉得最近我离目标越来越近了。就快把它拔出来了。也快找到我这一生都在问的那些问题的答案了。

lines.en: : Meaning...what exactly?
lines.zh: 意思……具体是什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Meaning I might finally be worth something to her.
lines.zh: 意思是，我也许终于对她有点价值了。

lines.en: : And that I can avoid the same fate.
lines.zh: 也能让我避开同样的结局。
